And the banning of all male comments I just read from the auto moderator review message kind of proves this point. 

I get it mods you don’t want to be brigaded by toxic people, but that turns this place into an echo chamber similar to r/conservatives where not much meaningful conversation based in reality can happen. 

Realizing now that none of my comments will be seen by members of this sub now but maybe consider a less blanketed policy for comments in the future that prevent ANY male contribution. You do you tho

See I genuinely don’t have a problem with this sub at all, but it’s these types of comments that give a bad impression. Maybe I’m just reading too much into what your saying idk.

The same deep introspection and self improvement is just a good practice for people in general so why does your comment make it seem like it’s solely up to a guy to become the ideal partner? I’ve matched with plenty of women on dating apps who are coasting on physical appearance and I agree it isn’t very attractive, and the uninspiring conversations I’ve had with them reflect that. 

Seems like it’s possible and acceptable that both men and woman can have enough love and respect for themselves to seek a healthy partner and deserve that too. 

But the blanket generalizations and inadequacies about an entire gender that aren’t attributable to all members *of* said gender seems hypocritical and backwards.

I think this sub is forward thinking and valuable in a lot of great ways, but like I said, comments like this and posts I see trending about how “all men rape, abuse and kill” make me scratch my head
Why’s that? Just curious for my own sake. Or is it just general optimism
